_comment: Run sizes. Runs advance in monthly TICKS. `every` is how many ticks pass between decisions: the kernel moves every tick, the government decides every tick, and residents and firms decide on their own cadence and hold what they chose in between. `tickMs` is how long a tick takes in live pace (150000 ms = 2.5 minutes, so a year is 30 minutes). `local` fits a single 7B on a laptop; `dgx` assumes a batching server (vLLM or SGLang). `substeps` and `rounds` apply only to the older two-year mode.
